title: Exemptions.
bodyText: The fund shall be exempt from the application of title 7, title 8, and title 9, in conducting the fund's business.
bodyHtml: [§386A-11]  Exemptions.  The fund shall be exempt from the application of title 7, title 8, and title 9, in conducting the fund's business. [L 1985, c 296, pt of §11]
